title: Register a Model and Customize List View
description: Register the Post model with the admin and customize the list display, search, and filters.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Assume you have a `Post` model with fields: `title`, `content`, `author` (ForeignKey to User), `published_date` (DateTimeField), and `is_published` (BooleanField).

Create a custom `ModelAdmin` class and register it. Customize:
- `list_display` to show title, author, published_date, and is_published.
- `list_filter` to filter by is_published and author.
- `search_fields` to search by title and content.
- `ordering` to show newest posts first (by published_date).

Test by logging into the admin and verifying the changes.
expectedOutput: In the admin list view for Post, you see columns for title, author, published_date, is_published; a search box; and filters on the right.
solutionCode:
# admin.py
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Post

@admin.register(Post)
class PostAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ('title', 'author', 'published_date', 'is_published')
    list_filter = ('is_published', 'author')
    search_fields = ('title', 'content')
    ordering = ('-published_date',)
